kjv: he willingly walked after the commandment
mine: he was determined to go after worthless precepts
note: tsav is obscure (perhaps a mocking word "precept" as in Isa 28:10, or "filth/vanity"); KJV's "the commandment" sounds like obedience to God, the opposite of the context.
melekh yarev is best read malki rav "the great king", the Assyrian royal title (sharru rabu); no king Jareb is known.
